args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money

src/money.py documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per
FIN-212) but quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP, causing the nightly build
to fail because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding.
Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so exact-half cases round to the even cent
(e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), while `src/money.py` quantized with ROUND_HALF_UP despite its docstring saying ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

## Change

- Single-line fix in `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP` so exact-half cases round to the even cent (e.g. 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

## Validation

- CI run `ci-0001` (commit 08d3cd5986) passed on branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding`.

Fixes the FIN-212 nightly test failures; needs to ship in today's release.
